'''2007 Yavin 4 Regionals Patrick Johnson LS We Have A Plan''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Patrick Johnson]] at [[2007 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We Have A Plan / They Will Be Lost And Confused|Theed-L-wehaveaplan.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Pat Johnson
* '''Deck name:''' WHAP
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
